name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper standard terms for a mutual NDA, allowing each party to disclose and protect confidential information while evaluating a business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period, and governing law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, used with a cover page and order forms.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper SLA covering uptime and support commitments, designed to accompany the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper DPA governing processing of personal data between a controller and processor, including subprocessor relationships.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for early-stage products where a design partner gets access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for professional services engagements, with statements of work describing deliverables and terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for two companies cooperating on a partnership, such as referrals, co-marketing or integrations.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper BAA setting out HIPAA obligations between a covered entity and a business associate handling protected health information.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for licensing software (e.g. on-premise or installed) to a customer, used with a cover page and order forms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper addendum adding terms for AI services, including use of customer data and AI outputs, to an underlying commercial agreement.
